game.title: Monster Hunter: World
game.blurb: Action RPG about hunting giant monsters in a newly settled continent, the New World, from Capcom, released 2018-01-26. RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: A hunter joins the expedition to the New World to follow the Elder Crossing. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Hunts, Quests and Crowns
chapters.summary: Optional quests, investigations, the arena, captures, elder dragons, monster research and crown sizes.

chapters.title: Life in the New World and Gear
chapters.summary: Camps, fishing, cooking, Tailraiders, Palico gadgets, your room, zenny, rare weapons and armour.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: SOS flares, co-op quests and Guild Cards.

chapters.title: Iceborne Story (expansion)
chapters.summary: The Iceborne story in master rank. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Iceborne: Master Rank and the Hoarfrost Reach
chapters.summary: Hoarfrost Reach camps, the clutch claw, Raider Ride, treasure, room decor, the Steamworks, master rank hunts and crowns.

StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Monster_Hunter:_World
Fandom (monsterhunter.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://monsterhunter.fandom.com/wiki/Monster_Hunter:_World
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist. monsterhunter.fandom.com answers the API, with about 170 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "ProjectA" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 582010. The 100 Steam achievements cover the base game (1 to 50) and the Iceborne expansion (51 to 100, opened by "Unlock all achievements for Monster Hunter World: Iceborne"). 35 are hidden. The 13 hidden ones in the Iceborne block with high unlock rates (12 to 37 percent) were put in the Iceborne story chapter, and the 8 with very low rates (about 2 to 5 percent, such as "Golden Gleam" and "Creatures of the Earth") in the Iceborne master rank chapter, by schema position; both need checking. The base game's 14 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter; "A Living Fossil", "Snuggles for All", "Bristles for All" and "Rainbow Bright" (3 to 8 percent) and "Temper Temper" and "Indomitable" are probably optional content.
